name: Nerest Client
changelog_title: Nerest 1.8.30: Chams NightShader, ShulkerViewer, Zoom, MCA & Launcher version
changelog: Updated Chams NightShader to match BlockOverlay with depth-sorted shader faces, style, hue, intensity, and quality (256/512/1024) settings.
Added ShulkerViewer module (ported from sourceblix) for inventory hover and dropped shulker box previews.
Added Zoom module (ported 1:1 from Velora) with native 26.52 FOV hook, smooth lerp, and mouse-wheel zoom.
Launcher now displays the actual build version from version.json instead of hardcoded 1.4.
